scenes.headline: Nobody watches your first second.
scenes.voiceover: Nobody is watching your first second. So stop wasting it.

scenes.headline: Habit one: open with the payoff
scenes.subline: Say the result before the setup.
scenes.voiceover: Habit one. Open with the payoff. Tell people what they get before you tell them how.

scenes.headline: Retention by hook type
scenes.voiceover: Videos that open with the result keep almost twice as many viewers past three seconds.

scenes.headline: It works on every platform
scenes.voiceover: And this works everywhere. Shorts, Reels, and Facebook video all reward the same first second.

scenes.headline: One idea per video
scenes.voiceover: Habit two. One idea per video. Three ideas is a playlist, not a Short.

scenes.headline: Habit three: end on a loop
scenes.subline: Your last frame is your next hook.
scenes.voiceover: Habit three. End on a loop. Your last frame should feel like the start of the next one.

titles: 3 Habits of Creators Who Actually Grow
Why Nobody Watches Your First Second
seo.description: Three habits that separate creators who grow from creators who stall: open with the payoff, one idea per video, end on a loop.
